svg.text: Spiking SSM detector: where it sits, and how it differs from PureSSM
All four models share one frozen pipeline; only the backbone changes.
the only part that differs between models
FROZEN - identical in all four models
(also: loss, Gen1 data pipeline, evaluator, training recipe)
inside one backbone stage - two orthogonal mixing axes
mixes across H, W - within ONE frame
(L·B, C, H, W) time folded into batch
stateless · may be bidirectional (space is not causal)
mixes across time - at ONE pixel
(B·H·W, L, C) space folded into batch
so a block there would be dead parameters.
What each model changes - the two axes are independent
PureSSM moved the SPATIAL axis; Spiking-SSM moves the TEMPORAL one - so the spiking block is spatial-agnostic and pairs with either backbone.
The caret marks the changed box. S5-RVT is the reproduced published baseline; EventSSM / PureSSM / Spiking-SSM are drop-in backbone swaps into its pipeline. mAP is COCO 0.50:0.95, Gen1 test split.
The LIF readout - measured from the implementation, not drawn by hand
per timestep t, at every pixel and channel
leaky integration of the SSM output
forward: a hard step. backward: arctan surrogate gradient.
Without the surrogate the derivative is zero almost everywhere
and nothing downstream of the spike can train.
membrane potential integrating the Mamba-2 output
Each spike drops the membrane by exactly one threshold: the residue
above threshold is carried forward, not discarded.
